acceptance.note: the run sheet's Dt = 1 min fails at t = 30 (114.391 -> 114.4); user decision 28 Oct: Dt = 0.1 min with the same Cl. 8.2.3 difference equations (150 sub-steps per 15-min step)

definition.reference_load: metered DT currents [our choice; plan 'actual load']
definition.initial_state: steady state at the 2024-01-01 00:00 load and ambient
definition.warm_up: 2024-01-01 excluded from every metric [our choice; 3 tau_o ~ 9 h]
definition.event: a DT-day whose reference theta_h exceeds the threshold at any sub-step (Dt = 0.1 min) [our choice]
definition.peak_at_step: start of the 15-min step holding the peak sub-step

load_temperature_correlation.definition: Pearson r, daily mean K_oil vs daily mean ERA5 ambient, 2024-01-02..2024-12-31

lstm_selection.criterion: lowest mean over the 13 DTs of the hot-spot RMSE over all April origins x 96 steps (seed-mean forecast, main parameter set) across the 12 candidates (6 direct + 6 residual); tie-break fewer parameters
lstm_selection.divergence_check: a seed has diverged if its best validation loss is NaN or its April explained variance of K_p is <= 0 (user decision 28 Oct; worse than persistence is a finding, not a stop)
lstm_selection.explained_variance: 1 - MSE(forecast) / MSE(per-series mean K_p over the training target days), pooled over April origins x 96 steps x 39 series
